header: L5 · The agent as a user · sonnet
verdict: All 7 round-9 L5 resolutions read as stated at the baseline. Two Advisory defects in the delta; no Required or Blocking.

findings.defect: The gap line says 'the session ended without /handoff', but its condition (facts differ from the narrative's stamped facts) also holds when /handoff ran and the agent then committed before /clear.
findings.scenario: The agent runs /handoff, makes one more commit, then /clear. SessionEnd's facts show a new commit; the next SessionStart prints 'the session ended without /handoff', which is false, so the agent learns to distrust the line.
findings.change: Word the line for what is measured, e.g. 'the newest facts differ from the latest narrative (<n> new commits since <time>)', and add a golden for handoff, commit, /clear.

findings.defect: With ssh-add -c, each signing use needs a confirmation on the host, and on macOS (no askpass) the spec now says confirm-on-use may not exist. It does not say what the agent sees when a confirmation is pending, denied or unavailable, or what it should do.
findings.scenario: The agent runs git commit; signing fails or hangs on a host prompt; it retries, or disables commit.gpgsign, with no hook or skill text telling it to stop and ask the operator.
findings.change: Add to the julieta skill rule and to probe B2 the observed failure text of a refused or unanswered signing use, and tell the agent not to unset signing and to ask the operator.

pages_read: docs/reviews/lenses.md (L5, What a reviewer returns, How stage A runs)
out_of_scope: Plan acceptance rows for L5-r9-4 are parked for stage B and not re-reported. ADR 0010 and the CI/ruleset parts of the delta were skimmed only; they do not touch the agent's view.
confidence: Medium: Advisory items follow from reading 06 and 08; hook runtime behavior is probe C5.
